exposure: Premature rupture of membranes or rupture of membranes 18 h before birth
cohort: Singleton births at four district hospitals in Pemba Island, Tanzania, between September 13th and November 29th 2019
finding: The stillbirth rate in the cohort was 22 per 1000 total births, and risk factors included breech or cephalic malpresentation, decreased or no foetal movements, caesarean section, previous CS, preeclampsia, premature rupture of membranes or rupture of membranes 18 h before birth and meconium stained amniotic fluid.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with a 5.19 increased odds of stillbirth compared to vaginal delivery.
